item.title: Jason Obawemimo's resume, October 2026: AI implementation, workflow automation and CRM systems
item.description: Jason Obawemimo owns and operates Triple J Auto Investment, a Houston dealership, and builds the CRM, voice AI and automation systems that run it. Since June 2025 he has personally closed 53 vehicle sales and collected $206,777 in sale proceeds. At Triple J he built a custom dealership CRM with its Handle a Sale desk (one system, used daily by three staff), an inbound voice AI that books appointments into the CRM, and a prospecting workflow that researches leads with the Claude API. He is pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Neuroscience at The University of Texas at Austin, expected 2028, and holds an Associate of Arts in Business from San Jacinto College. He is also the founder of Obavia, a dealership sale desk in development for Texas independent dealers.

item.title: Obavia: building a sale desk for Texas independent dealers
item.description: Jason Obawemimo is the founder of Obavia (https://obavia.co), a dealership sale desk in development for Texas independent dealers. "Every sale, start to signed." The Obavia film is on the Obavia page; people and figures in it are fictional. Obavia is in development; asking for early access does not grant product access.

item.title: Triple J: Handle a Sale
item.description: A demo of Handle a Sale, the sale desk in the CRM Jason Obawemimo built for Triple J Auto Investment in Houston and the system the dealership closes sales on. It asks one plain question at a time, scans the buyer's license once so every form fills itself, does the registration math, routes the deal to the right documents with nothing missing and nothing extra, works in English or Spanish, and saves every sale on file.

item.title: Obavia becomes the sale desk for Texas dealers
item.description: Obavia is now a sale desk: every sale, start to signed, for Texas independent dealers. It grew out of Handle a Sale, the sale desk in the CRM Jason Obawemimo built for Triple J Auto Investment in Houston. It is in development, with early access for Texas dealers.

item.title: Jason Obawemimo walks you through the site, and speaks
item.description: jasonobawemimo.com opens on a loading screen built from Jason Obawemimo's portrait, plays a short signature film, and asks why you are here. Jason then guides you through the page: the camera scrolls to each proof, phrases are underlined, circled or crossed out, and every line is spoken aloud. Everything is skippable, and every fact stays in plain HTML.
